packets.patch.description: Apply in the field: restores 6 to your health pool.
packets.hype.description: Hype up one drawn card: +8 STR / RNG / MAG for the encounter.
packets.shield.description: Raise a shield on one drawn card: +4 DEF for the encounter.
packets.reroute.description: Reroute the hand: redraw up to four cards, right now.
packets.venom.description: Lace every blade: this encounter, your units' hits inject poison.
packets.overclock.description: Overclock a roster unit: +8 STR / RNG / MAG for the next encounter.
packets.surge.description: Surge the deck: draw three extra cards into this turn's hand.
packets.discard-one.description: Cull one drawn card: send it to the discard, no refill.
